articles.title: Iraqi PM cracks down on Kurds' control of oilfields, Kurds reject risky move
articles.description: By Kawa Omar, Zainab Elhaj, Maher Nazih and Maha El DahanBAGHDAD, Nov 24 (Reuters) - Iraq's prime minister has ordered federal authorities to manage oilfields in four provinces under the control of the Kurds, in a risky move likely to further strain relations with their semi-autonomous region after he sought to rein in a heavily armed pro-Iranian militia.

articles.title: Iraq's Zaidi emerges as risk-taker in showdowns against militias and Kurds
articles.description: By Ahmed Rasheed and Michael GeorgyBAGHDAD/DUBAI, Nov 24 (Reuters) - Just six months since taking power as a political novice, Iraq's Prime Minister Alial-Zaidi has emerged as an unexpectedly bold risk-taker, launching simultaneous showdowns against armed Iran-backed Shi'ite militias and the semi-autonomous Kurds.The two moves put the 41-year-old multimillionaire businessman on a course for direct confrontation with two of the most powerful entrenched groups that have defied Baghdad's central control for decades.
